raw_segments.text: Paulina, there is none worthy respecting her that's gone.
Besides, the gods will have fulfilled their secret purposes.
For has not the divine Apollo said, Is not the tenor of his oracle,
That King Lience shall not have an heir till his lost child be found?
Which that it shall, is all as monstrous to our human reason as my antigonus to break
his grave and come again to me, Who, on my life, did perish with the infant.
Tease your counsel, my lord, should to the heavens be contrary.
To Lience, care not for issue.
The crown will find an heir.
Great Alexander left his to Th worthiest, so his successor was liked to be the best.
